description: Three-phase panel multimeters (M2M with RS485, DMTME-I-485), Modbus RTU
source: ABB, "M2M/DMTME Instruments - Communication protocol", technical specification V2.0, 2CSG445011D0201; https://library.abb.com/d/2CSG445011D0201
notes: ABB M2M (MODBUS, ALARM and I/O models) and DMTME-I-485 multimeters over RS485.
Every value is a 32-bit long (2 registers, high word first); reads and writes use FC03 and FC16. Up to 24 values (48 registers) per read.
Registers marked M2M only read as 0 on the DMTME. Active and reactive powers are unsigned on the DMTME.
A power factor or cos phi of 2.000 (raw 2000) means not available, e.g. with no current.
The instrument type and firmware are only given by FC11 Report slave ID: 80 = DMTME-I-485, 57 = M2M MODBUS, 58 = M2M ALARM, 59 = M2M I/O.
Serial settings: 8 data bits, parity even, odd or none, 2400-19200 baud (DMTME) or 4800-19200 baud (M2M). Set the address on the instrument.
